{{Quote|My mother says the Force moves in mysterious ways&mdash;and I never cease to be amazed at how right she is.|Jan Ors|<ref name="Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>}}
[[Jan Ors]]' '''mother''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[choreographer]] in a [[Alderaan's premier ballet company|premier ballet company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was also a key founding member in the [[Justice Action Network]], an extremist organization that rallied against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and Alderaan's post-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] pacifism, along with [[Jan Ors' father]] and [[Earnst Kamiel]]. Jan Ors' [[Parent/Legends|mother]] taught her daughter how to dance and often commented that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] moved in mysterious ways.
